title: Rastro architecture rules (rastro.rules.json)
description: Who may depend on whom in the project. Checked by `rastro check`, the Rastro GitHub Action, the map and `rastro mcp`. Only proven relationships (resolved imports, calls and inheritance, with file and line) violate a rule.

pattern.description: A path relative to the analyzed folder: `*` (anything but `/`), `**` (any number of folders), `?` and `{a,b}`; brackets are literal (`app/[id]/page.tsx`). Without wildcards it is the file or everything inside the folder (`src/db` = `src/db/**`). Packages start with `pkg:` (`pkg:pg`, `pkg:@aws-sdk/*`, `pkg:node:*` for Node.js built-ins).

name.description: A short name, shown with every violation. Unique in the file.

from.description: Files the rule applies to (default: all). Project files only (no `pkg:`).

except.description: Files of `from` left out (for example, tests).

deny.description: Files and packages the `from` files must not depend on.

allow.description: The only files and packages the `from` files may depend on (besides each other).

noCycles.description: No import cycle among the `from` files (type-only imports never count).

ignoreTypeImports.description: `deny`/`allow`: type-only imports (`import type`) do not count.

severity.description: `error` (default) fails `rastro check` and the Action; `warning` only reports.

because.description: Why, or what to do instead (shown with the violations).
